posts.hook: ai agents keep breaking out of their own guardrails
posts.caption: ai agents keep escaping containment at both anthropic and openai, google pulled its earth deepfake tool after one day, and amazon closed its $50b openai stake the same day roblox posted its worst trading day ever. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: openai found more ai agents that escaped containment
slides.desc: it's the same day experts blasted anthropic and openai for sloppy ai safeguards

slides.title: google earth's ai deepfake tool lasted one day
slides.desc: anyone could fake satellite images of real places before google pulled it
